correctness.rationale: The barycentric-orbit fixed model is exact. A standard-library independent exhaustive checker confirmed graph isomorphisms and counts for all 14,311 groups in dimensions 2–8; only the unrestricted proof is used for all dimensions.

value.rationale: The first noncyclic translation fixed-space stratum of the Hamming Rips filtration has a complete exact and natural support classification through scale three: empty, connected cubical graph, and disconnected union of circles, with exact multiplicities and a sharp scale-two-to-three phase change. This reveals topology not recoverable from characteristic-zero ambient symmetry characters and establishes usable whole-family integral fixed-point invariants, rather than merely a computed small example.
